parts.content:
Case-insensitive parsing works, whitespace is trimmed, and invalid input still fails properly.

**Cause:** `BoolParamType.convert` in `src/click/types.py` stripped whitespace but compared against lowercase-only literal sets with a case-sensitive `in` check, so `TRUE`, `Yes`, `Off`, etc. fell through to `self.fail(...)`.

**Fix:** Normalize case as well as whitespace — `norm = value.strip().lower()` — so the existing literal sets match regardless of casing. One-line change, no behavior change for valid lowercase input, no test files touched.
